column1: # anatomy_pins.tsv — exact per-counter work-volume pins for the T1 encoder.
# Cargo feature: anatomy-counters. These counters exist ONLY in that
# feature's build; the default (shipped) build compiles every call site to
# zero bytes and never reads this file.
# Scope: T1 ONLY (in-process encode_gzip_bytes_to_vec, the production T1
# entry point). T>1 work distribution is schedule-dependent and unpinned.
# Grid: src/fixtures.rs synthetic fixtures x levels {1, 2, 6, 9}.
# Counters are a calibrated wall proxy ONLY after per-arch calibration:
# a measured -27% write-count moved wall 0%, while a -21% Ir moved wall
# 5.4%. Pins catch CHANGES — they do not price them. A pin diff names the
# mechanism; the wall verdict still needs paired runs on the frozen box.
